pkgmetadata.longdescription:
The official DigitalOcean command-line client (historically named "doit" and published in the DigitalOcean community as "DoCli"), which leverages the DigitalOcean API to provide access to DigitalOcean services: Droplets, Kubernetes (DOKS), App Platform, Spaces, databases, load balancers, VPCs, container registry and the serverless/functions runtime.
Built from the upstream -source release tarball, which ships a complete vendor/ tree, so the build needs no network access. Bash, zsh and fish completions are generated from the built binary and installed.
